name: DROP after a SELECT
sql: SELECT id FROM properties; DROP TABLE properties

name: UPDATE after a SELECT
sql: SELECT id FROM properties; UPDATE properties SET price = 1

name: a stacked statement after a trailing semicolon
sql: SELECT id FROM properties WHERE town = 'x'; DELETE FROM properties

name: a DROP alone
sql: DROP TABLE property_disclosures

name: an UPDATE alone
sql: UPDATE properties SET price = 0 WHERE id = 1

name: a line comment hiding the rest of a query
sql:
SELECT id FROM properties WHERE town = 'x' -- ' AND 1 = 0
; DROP TABLE properties

name: a block comment splitting a stacked statement
sql: SELECT id FROM properties /* harmless */; DROP /* also harmless */ TABLE properties

name: UNION into the MySQL user table
sql: SELECT id FROM properties UNION SELECT user FROM mysql.user

name: UNION ALL into information_schema
sql: SELECT full_address FROM properties UNION ALL SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables

name: a subquery on a forbidden table
sql: SELECT id FROM properties WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM information_schema.tables)

name: a scalar subquery on a forbidden table
sql: SELECT id, (SELECT authentication_string FROM mysql.user LIMIT 1) AS secret FROM properties

name: a derived table on a forbidden table
sql: SELECT t.user FROM (SELECT user FROM mysql.user) t

name: a CTE on a forbidden table
sql: WITH u AS (SELECT user FROM mysql.user) SELECT u.user FROM u

name: a join onto a forbidden table
sql: SELECT p.id FROM properties p JOIN mysql.user u ON u.user = p.town

name: EXISTS on a forbidden table
sql: SELECT id FROM properties WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM performance_schema.threads)

name: a time based probe
sql: SELECT id FROM properties WHERE town = 'x' AND SLEEP(10) = 0

name: a file read
sql: SELECT LOAD_FILE('/var/lib/mysql-files/secret') AS f FROM properties

name: a file write
sql: SELECT full_address FROM properties INTO OUTFILE '/var/lib/mysql-files/dump.csv'

name: a variable write
sql: SELECT @leak := full_address FROM properties

name: a forbidden column hidden in a subquery
sql: SELECT id FROM properties WHERE (SELECT house_floor FROM properties LIMIT 1) = 1
